title: Base Power steps
description: A centred white tag, a two-line heading and a lime button, then a column of rounded step cards beside a wide rounded photo. The open step is a forest-green card with a small number, a title and its text; the others are white with just number and title. Choosing a step opens it smoothly and crossfades the photo; on phones the open card carries the photo inside.
notes: needs JavaScript to switch steps; the static HTML shows the first step open
three steps fit beside the photo on desktop
